question: How is rainfall associated with PM2.5 in Mumbai?

final.answer: In Mumbai, measured PM2.5 was associated with rainfall: the mean was 19.3 µg/m³ on rain days compared to 39.2 µg/m³ on dry days (Spearman rho = -0.644, 95% range -0.696 to -0.587, 536 days).
final.headline: In Mumbai, measured PM2.5 was associated with rainfall: the mean was 19.3 µg/m³ on rain days compared to 39.2 µg/m³ on dry days (Spearman rho = -0.644, 95% range -0.696 to -0.587, 536 days).
final.explanation: This shows an association, not a cause, covering 243 rain days and 293 dry days out of 536 days total, with 51 date(s) in this period having severe network-wide data gaps.
final.method: Measured PM + modelled weather: PM2.5 and rainfall in Mumbai, 2025-02-18 to 2026-11-11. 22 primary stations (primary). 536 matched days. Method: Spearman rank correlation between daily city PM and the daily weather value; days grouped into quartiles (or dry/rain) to show average PM per group.
